comment: Published catalogue values of the Haas VF-2 (Haas Automation, VF-2 specifications page, haascnc.com). X travel 762 mm, 8100 rpm, 22.4 kW, 122 N m, rapids 25.4 m/min, cutting feed 16.5 m/min (650 in/min), 20 tools, 4.2 s tool change and rigid tapping are the values recorded from that page in PLAN.md 3.6; Y 406 mm and Z 508 mm are the published VF-2 travels of 16 and 20 in, from memory of that page. The page refused automated reading when this file was made, so none was re-checked. Axis signs follow the usual Haas convention (home at 0, travel negative): check. Acceleration and the block and program name limits are not published: 0 = unknown. Not verified on a real machine.
name: Generic VMC, Haas NGC style (VF-2 class)
